cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.description: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.description: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.description: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.description: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.description: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.description: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.description: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.description: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.description: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.description: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.description: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.description: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.description: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

cards.name: Ekans
cards.description: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.description: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.description: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

cards.name: Nidoran♀
cards.description: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran's horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male's horn.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.description: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.description: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

cards.name: Nidoran♂
cards.description: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it's friendly with.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.description: It's nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.description: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It's forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they're usually found in quiet places.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.description: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.description: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.description: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Paras
cards.description: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.description: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.description: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.description: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.description: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

cards.name: Persian
cards.description: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.description: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.description: This Pokémon's sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies' grasp and escape.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.description: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

cards.name: Abra
cards.description: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

cards.name: Kadabra
cards.description: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

cards.name: Machop
cards.description: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.description: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.description: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.description: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.description: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.description: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.description: This Pokémon is mostly made of water. A Tentacool out in the ocean is very hard to spot, because its body blends in with the sea.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.description: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and shrink freely. Tentacruel ensnares prey in a net of spread-out tentacles, delivering venomous stings to its catch.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.description: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.description: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.description: If you've been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.description: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd's pace and direction of travel.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.description: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.description: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.description: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.description: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

cards.name: Seel
cards.description: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.description: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.description: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

cards.name: Muk
cards.description: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.description: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.description: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.description: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.description: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.description: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.description: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

cards.name: Kingler
cards.description: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.description: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.description: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.description: Bug Pokémon are Lickitung's main food source. This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick from its long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.description: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.description: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.description: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.description: Seadra's mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that's larger than the opening of its mouth.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.description: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.description: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn't bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.description: It's known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: With the coming of a storm, many of these Pokémon will gather under tall trees and sit there waiting for lightning to strike.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: These Pokémon's bodies are constantly burning. Magmar are feared as one of the causes behind fires.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.description: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.description: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.description: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.description: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.description: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.description: In recent years, this species has been very helpful in cyberspace. These Pokémon will go around checking to make sure no suspicious data exists.

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.description: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it's just drifting along.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.description: Omastar's sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.

cards.name: Kabuto
cards.description: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.

cards.name: Kabutops
cards.description: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.description: Aerodactyl's sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.description: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.description: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.description: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.description: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

cards.description: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It's forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

cards.name: Psyduck
